literal_meaning: লেজের সঙ্গে খেলা করা (tail with play to do)
figurative_meaning_bn: চাতুরী করা; কারও সঙ্গে ক্রমাগত চালাকি করা
figurative_meaning_en: To act cunningly; to continuously deceive or outsmart someone
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বন্ধুকে লেজে খেলিয়ে সময় কাটাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The police are playing games with this matter.
He is toying with his friend to pass the time.
note: The idiom draws from the image of an animal wagging or playing with its tail, metaphorically implying evasive or playful deception.
